note: 50 cases. Composition follows docs/testing-strategy.md section 5.1: 30 bucket A, 8 bucket B, 10 bucket C, 2 adversarial. Bucket A key facts were read from the converted corpus; the Summary of Benefits conversion was hand-verified against the source PDF in Stage 1. Cases marked enforced:false describe behaviour the build does not yet guarantee, so Stage 6 and Stage 8 gains are visible rather than assumed. Six questions are written in member register (rambling, no jargon, question buried mid-sentence); testing-strategy section 5.1 recommends eight, so this is two short and recorded as a known gap rather than silently missing. Refusal is a typed outcome from Stage 6 onward, and bucket C is decided by rule before retrieval from Stage 8, so these cases are enforced rather than observed.
